newsitem.title: UK: Lynx Holdings targets new markets.
newsitem.headline: Lynx Holdings targets new markets.

text.p: UK computer systems and communications firm Lynx Holdings Plc said on Thursday it will lay more stress on expansion ouside Britain in order to further consolidate its growth.

"The opportunities in mainland Europe and outside are more real," the company's managing director Richard Last told Reuters after it reported a 177 percent hike in its post-tax profit at 4.79 million stg.
Last said the company's recent acquisitions, Tesoft SA and Quadra, had contributed significantly towards the firm's turnover which more than doubled to 87.6 milliion stg from 32.0 million in 1995.
Lynx's earning per share rose 14 percent to 5.36p.

Tesoft, acquired by Lynx last March, was awarded a 4.0 million stg dearship network contract by Renault Italy. Lynx now plans to open an office in Rome soon. Outside the U.K., the company has another office in Madrid.
"Our immediate focus is the automobile sector in Europe," Last added.
Last said Lynx was looking foward to more business through Wireless Data Systems, its 50:50 joint venture in Auckland, New Zealand.
"Our partner International Wireless has some good clients," said Last.
The venture is seeking to provide data soon in Taiwan and Indonesia and further in the Pacific rim. Transportation and security firms will be Lynx's main clients in this region, Last said.
Lynx was also exploring the Latin American market, he added.
"We are looking at the Latin American automobile sector," Last said. "It (entry) should be either through a commercial cooperation or a joint venture".
With about 3.8 million cash at hand, Last ruled out any immediate move to raise fresh funds, loans or equity.
"We have substantial sums to finance an acquisition", Last said.
